cases.stdout:
usage: ov [-h] {observe,analyze,diff,report,synopsis,overview,evidence,check,runs,mcp} ...

OverView: web reconnaissance & analysis

positional arguments:
  {observe,analyze,diff,report,synopsis,overview,evidence,check,runs,mcp}
    observe             Capture a target into the store and print a summary of the run.
    analyze             Run the deterministic analyzers over a stored run (Phase 2).
    diff                Diff an analyzed run against a prior baseline run (own-target review
                        mode).
    report              Render Markdown report sections for a stored run (Phase 2).
    synopsis            Aggregate a run's findings into a single synopsis (synopsis.json +
                        SYNOPSIS.md).
    overview            observe -> analyze -> [diff in review mode] -> report -> synopsis (Phase
                        2).
    evidence            Build a grounded evidence bundle for a run (set-of-mark + token budget).
    check               Check system dependencies (Playwright browsers, Node, sidecar, CLIs).
    runs                List stored capture run ids.
    mcp                 Serve ov as an MCP server (stdio) for non-Claude-Code hosts (needs
                        ov[agents]).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
